subject: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)
body:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Rao <anita@norwestsolutions.com>, Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>, Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)

Team — putting a tight runbook together for the Norwest exec evening after the workshop on Tue the 25th. Goal: seamless arrival at 6:30pm, plated supper at 7:00pm, two short breakout toasts at 8:15pm, buses back to the hotel by 9:45pm. Key constraints: one VIP dietary restriction (no shellfish, pescatarian), two late arrivals (flight lands 6:10pm), and a vendor timing window — kitchen can only stage from 5:30–9:30pm.

Attached: seating map (PDF), guest rooming CSV, latest Blue Anchor menu. Please confirm the small assignments below and flag anything I missed.

Action items (assignments):
- Lauren: lead FOH contact with venue + manage the two ride-share pickup zones (curb 1 and curb 2). Confirm valet lanes with hotel by Mon 12:00pm.
- Marissa: guest welcome, name badges, and escort plan; run the dietary list with Blue Anchor (send updated CSV).
- Vivek: on-site tech checklist (mics for toasts, projector fallback, and one mobile hotspot) + own vendor payments at the event.

Karthik
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

--

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>, Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)

Thanks — quick notes from FOH: I confirmed curb 1 (main entrance) for busses and curb 2 (loading lane) for hires/ride-share. Hotel will staff two porters from 6:00–10:00pm. Valet lanes confirmed. Jonas says we have access to the service elevator from 5:15pm to 10:00pm for backstage loads.

Two asks for the vendor: can Blue Anchor compress the plated service by 10 minutes to get toasts earlier? We need to start the plated course at 7:00pm, but if two guests land late we may delay the starter a bit. Also: I flagged the VIP (Anita) as pescatarian, no shellfish.

—Lauren
Event Operations Manager

On Sat, Aug 22, 2026 at 12:45 PM Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com> wrote:
> From: Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>
> To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
> Cc: Anita Rao <anita@norwestsolutions.com>
> Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 12:45:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)
>
> Hi all — thanks for the run-down. We can shave 10 minutes off plated service by consolidating plating lines and pre-staging the hot indicators. That said, two late arrivals is tight — we recommend holding the salad course and plating the fish entree family-style for the table that includes the late guests so nobody waits more than 6–7 minutes.
>
> Confirmed: no shellfish for Anita, separate protein for guest 12 (nut allergy) — will label. We will send the revised menu PDF and staffing schedule by Mon EOD.
>
> Attachments (stubs): blueanchor_menu_v3.pdf (menu), staffing_schedule.xlsx (roster)
>
> Cheers,
> Blue Anchor Catering Ops

--

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Rao <anita@norwestsolutions.com>, Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>, Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)

Looping logistics and the updated guest list. I added rooming assignments for the Norwest execs (attached CSV). Quick notes from concierge: two rooms available for early check-in (both suite upgrades) — suggest we hold for the two late-arriving speakers if their flights clear.

Escort plan: welcome desk at hotel lobby (lauren), two greeters (me + temp staff), then escorted to private dining area. I will have printed name badges at the welcome desk by 6:00pm.

If Anita wants a private moment with the host prior to dinner (10–12 mins), can we hold a corner table at 6:20pm? Anita — let us know if that works.

Marissa
Customer Hospitality Lead

On Mon, Aug 24, 2026 at 10:15 AM Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com> wrote:
> From: Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com>
> To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
> Cc: Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>
> Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
> Subject: Re: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)
>
> Hi all — confirmed early check-in rooms reserved, porter roster attached. Valet and loading lanes have been mapped to the attached seating map. Service elevator code will be provided to your FOH lead (Lauren) on the morning of the event.
>
> One small ask from the hotel: please provide a final headcount and any last-minute dietary restrictions by 2:00pm on Tue (25th).
>
> Best,
> Jonas
> Director, Events — Hotel Maven

--

From: Anita Rao <anita@norwestsolutions.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)

Karthik + team — appreciate the organization. Two small updates from my side:
1) I actually prefer vegetarian (no shellfish, no poultry) for the evening — is that possible to accommodate at the same plated timeline?
2) One guest (R. Patel) is arriving on a later redeye and will not attend dinner — please remove from the seating map.

If veg for Anita is doable, please confirm and I'll send a quick note to the executive group so they know the plan.

Thanks — Anita
VP, Customer Success
Norwest Solutions

--

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Anita Rao <anita@norwestsolutions.com>, Blue Anchor Catering <orders@blueanchorcatering.com>, Jonas Franklin <jonas@hotelmaven.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final runbook: Supper + shuttle + rooming plan for Norwest on-site (Aug 25)

Thanks Anita — good catch. Marissa: can you update the guest CSV (remove R. Patel) and confirm final headcount to Jonas by 2:00pm Tuesday.

Blue Anchor: can you convert Anita's plated to a vegetarian main (no poultry, no shellfish) while keeping the timing the same? If that requires one alternate plate at the table, do it —— we want no visible delays.

Vendor payment: Vivek, we'll handle the catering tip and on-site invoice settlement after the event — I'll hand you the payment envelope at 9:30pm.

Lauren — please confirm valet/porter arrival schedule (6:00pm) and that service elevator code distribution will happen morning-of.

If everyone is aligned I will send a one-paragraph note to Anita's execs confirming arrival + escort plan.

Karthik

[End of thread]
